Brent crude, as of 17 July 2026: $88.10/bbl, +$3.87 (+4.59%).
"Brent extended its gains to above $87 per barrel on Friday, reaching its highest level in a month."
"oil prices have risen more than 14% this week as hostilities intensified, raising fears of a broader regional conflict."
Drivers: US completed sixth consecutive night of strikes on Iranian military sites; Iran retaliated against US targets in Kuwait, Jordan and Bahrain.
"Iran had instructed Houthi forces to prepare to disrupt shipping through the Red Sea" and commercial traffic through the Strait of Hormuz remained significantly limited.
